title: What If Earth Had Rings Like Saturn? Here's the Sky You'd See

scenes.text: What if Earth had rings like Saturn? They would never rise, and they would never set.
Earth's rings would be rock, not ice. Our Sun is too close, and any ice would boil away.
From the equator you'd see a thin line standing straight up. From middle latitudes, a giant arch across the sky.
If they reflected ten percent of sunlight, each square meter would shine like a 130 watt bulb, day and night.
The rings would cast shadows on Earth, so winters in both hemispheres could get colder and harsher.
They'd also scatter signals from satellites in orbit above the equator. Beautiful, but a nightmare for communications.
